annotations.title: Fill a template and print it

description: Fills a template with JSON data and prints it to PDF (a download link, valid 24 hours, and the edit link in the editor, where its template and data stay editable — until the person edits it on the page, which makes it a plain HTML document: then change its html). Either a gallery template (template_id from list_templates; without data it prints its sample) or your own template source. Send data in the shape of the template's sample (get_template). The language: read_guide topic "templates".

data.description: The values the template reads, in the shape of its sample data.

filename.description: The PDF file name. Default: the template's name or the document's <title>.

preview.description: A picture (PNG) of page 1 comes with the answer, so you can check the layout, fonts and images before giving the links. Default: true.

template.description: Your own template source (HTML with {{ value }}, {% for %}, {% if %}), instead of template_id.

template_id.description: A gallery template's id, from list_templates.

name: render_template
